name: malo-browser
description: Scripted browser demo tool and agent browser runtime: a visible Electron stage for live web demos, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API, plus a daemon handing out port leases with isolated, profile-backed browser sessions exposing 25 session tools (including network capture).

description_i18n.en: Scripted browser demo tool and agent browser runtime: a visible Electron stage for live web demos, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API, plus a daemon handing out port leases with isolated, profile-backed browser sessions exposing 25 session tools (including network capture).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 脚本化浏览器演示工具兼 agent 浏览器运行时：可见的 Electron 演示舞台、无头 1080p30 录制与证据文件、导演控制台与本地控制 API；守护进程按端口发放租约，提供隔离且可复用登录态的 session，共 25 个 session 工具（含网络抓包）。
